questions.question: Define the radius and diameter of a circle and explain how they are related, using a wheel with radius 30 cm.
questions.expected_answer: The radius joins the centre to the circle; the diameter is a chord through the centre. Diameter = 2 × radius, so the wheel's diameter is 60 cm.

questions.question: Explain the difference between a chord and an arc.
questions.expected_answer: A chord is a straight line segment with both ends on the circle; an arc is a curved part of the circumference between two points.

questions.question: Explain the difference between a sector and a segment.
questions.expected_answer: A sector is bounded by two radii and an arc, with the centre as a corner (pizza slice). A segment is bounded by a chord and an arc (piece cut off by one straight cut).
